visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of a white floral plate piled high with golden-brown fried stinky tofu, topped with shredded cabbage and a drizzle of red chili sauce. A person's hand is visible holding the camera, capturing the dish against the blurred background of a street food stall. (2) The camera cuts to an older female stall owner wearing a pink shirt, an apron, and a checkered bandana. She is wearing a surgical mask and is seen using a large knife to chop blocks of fried tofu on a wooden cutting board behind the glass counter. (3) A younger female worker in a black apron and purple latex gloves carries a full plate of tofu through the outdoor seating area towards a red-speckled table. A large blue electric fan is visible in the foreground, and customers are seen sitting at tables in the background. (4) The older stall owner is shown speaking directly toward the camera from behind her workstation. She is surrounded by stainless steel pots and containers filled with ingredients like pickled cabbage and sauces. (5) A series of close-ups focus on the tofu: a pair of stainless steel chopsticks lifts a square piece of tofu to reveal its porous, white interior; sauce is poured over the tofu; and more red chili paste is added from a glass jar using a small orange spoon. (6) A hand holds up a clear plastic bag filled with tofu for a takeaway shot, followed by a shot of a pink paper receipt with the shop's name and contact information. (7) The scene shifts to an indoor dining area with wooden tables, chairs, and a map on the wall. Finally, the camera shows the exterior of the stall, labeled with yellow signs reading '愛嬌姨臭豆腐', featuring the two women working under the bright daylight of a street-side environment.
